kind: offline native trace gate replay, no closed-loop rerun
scope_limits: Offline replay of one matched/noisy 10 s native trajectory, force and acceleration noise seed 29.
No native model, helper, controller, actuator, or report changes.
No new closed-loop run: altered readiness cannot be claimed to reproduce this fixed trajectory or solve the mechanical mode.
True force and programmed bump times used only for postprocessing validation/window selection, never in proposed gate.
Pending or controller-only notches require the final gate input bandwidth to be checked again.
No gate can withdraw already queued delayed robot commands or anticipate an unseen first force excursion.

signal_mapping.force_grid: every tenth native sample, 100 us, including t=0
signal_mapping.new_gate_input: Calibrated reconstructed workpiece-normal force before controller-only notch or rolloff, if that signal is available and channel transfers remain matched.

existing_gate_replay.near_target_uses: instantaneous error at robot-rate sample, not the 100 ms filtered mean
existing_gate_replay.trend_filter_recursion: m[k] = alpha*m[k-1] + (1-alpha)*error[k-1]; one robot-rate sample delay

fast_gate_recursions.variation_ok: v[k] <= 0.08^2 N^2; sqrt only needed for RMS diagnostic
fast_gate_recursions.stable_now: held existing slow stableNow AND variation_ok; update at 10 kHz
fast_gate_recursions.dwell: reset consecutive stable count to 0 on ANY 10 kHz failure, otherwise increment; ready only after 100 ms continuous stability (1001 samples including endpoints)
fast_gate_recursions.robot_command: sample fast ready at existing 100 Hz robot-command tick; fast readiness must not change force-controller sample rate

recommended_requalification: Native repeated bump run with the new gate wired into recentering, unchanged force controller and mechanical candidate.
Compare closure/recovery duty, queued robot motion while closed, force error, travel margin, and peak cell mode.
Repeat across selected mass/force/orientation/friction corners and independent noise seeds.
Retest on the final matched sensor/notch architecture; a filtered-away mode cannot be detected by variance of that filtered signal.
